items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: I think Sweets was playing. I says Man, get off of that bandstand and he let me on there and I played.

ctx.x: Billie said, yes, let him off here and let him play his little horn. I said that is right, darlin', that is what I wants to do.
And they would give me a couple, a little of that stuff you know and I was right, man. I was right. So, I went in there now, who was playing? I think Sweets was playing.
I says Man, get off of that bandstand and he let me on there and I played.
